seconds.description: A fixed duration in seconds, used instead of an absolute `date`.

format.description: How the remaining time is rendered. `auto` (default) drops units that are zero.

date.description: Target date/time to count down to. `to` is accepted as an alias; `date` is read first.

to.description: Alias of `date`, read only when `date` is absent.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
_metadata.note: Expand by hand: enums, richer descriptions and accessibility notes cannot be read from source.
